results.title: Invariant random C*-subalgebras of products of hyperbolic groups
results.summary: A draft extending boomerang subalgebra rigidity to finite products of torsion-free nonamenable hyperbolic groups and countable restricted direct sums. The proposed classification identifies every invariant random C*-subalgebra with a unique invariant random subgroup. The proof combines selective tensor averaging, coordinatewise centering, and mixed Fourier-coefficient extraction. Prepared with substantial AI assistance; independent human mathematical review is pending.

results.title: Strongly Choquet–Deny groups and the FC-center
results.summary: A note extending the finitely generated classification of Dantas and Doucha to countable groups: the strongly Choquet–Deny groups are precisely the virtually FC groups, with the same characterization for the positive condition. The argument adapts their renorming criterion and analytic obstruction, adding finite conjugacy averaging and a sequence construction when the FC-center has infinite index. AI-assisted draft for discussion; independent mathematical review is pending.

results.title: Hyperrigidity in low dimensions and a dimension-33 counterexample
results.summary: Version 2 proves hyperrigidity for every compact convex subset of R3 with closed extreme boundary, retains the explicit affine-dimension-33 counterexample, and establishes the range 4 ≤ d_min ≤ 33. The revised proof uses a dilation replacement and bounded Borel endpoint interpolation, avoiding disintegration. Includes further construction obstructions and a finite-POVM criterion. Working draft, not a published paper or released preprint; independent human mathematical verification is pending.

results.title: Kirchberg algebras as full amalgams of stably finite algebras
results.summary: A proposed decomposition of unital Kirchberg algebras as full amalgamated free products of stably finite algebras. Public draft 2, with conditional Lean verification through external analytic interfaces; independent human mathematical verification is pending.

results.title: Cubic lower bounds for conjugacy separation in nilpotent groups
results.summary: A research draft proposing cubic lower bounds, in Hirsch length, for conjugacy separability growth in torsion-free finitely generated nilpotent groups, with a companion Lean formalization of the lower-bound construction. Independent human review of the claims and their correspondence with the formalization is pending.

results.title: Rapid Decay and C*-Simplicity: A Supplementary Sunflower Proof
results.summary: A supplementary AI-assisted sunflower proof relating rapid decay, the amenable radical, and C*-simplicity, with an extension to sub-rapid decay.
